# The intra-workspace dependency DAG, asserted by the `repo-invariants` CI job against
# `cargo metadata`. One edge per line: "<crate> -> <dependency>". Sorted.
#
# The load-bearing absence is `boid-search -> boid-eval-*`. If search ever depends on a
# concrete evaluator, issue #13's decision gate and issue #16's ablation campaign become a
# loop over cargo builds instead of a loop over UCI options, and every SPRT result carries
# a build-provenance question. See docs/DECISIONS.md D-0010.
#
# boid-board itself has no outgoing edges and no external dependencies at all.
boid-eval-boids -> boid-board
boid-eval-classical -> boid-board
boid-search -> boid-board
boid-tune -> boid-board
boid-tune -> boid-eval-boids
boid-tune -> boid-eval-classical
boid-tune -> boid-search
boid-tune -> boid-uci
boid-uci -> boid-board
boid-uci -> boid-eval-boids
boid-uci -> boid-eval-classical
boid-uci -> boid-search
boid-web -> boid-board
boid-web -> boid-eval-boids
boid-web -> boid-eval-classical
boid-web -> boid-search
